name: How long does it take to install accessible light switches in a home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install accessible light switches in a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for accessible light switches depends on the number of switches being replaced and whether any new wiring is required. A direct replacement of a standard switch with a similar accessible type (e.g., rocker switch) can take as little as 15-30 minutes per switch. More complex installations, such as adding smart switches that require hub configuration or new wiring, could take longer per unit or require a half-day to full-day for a whole-house upgrade. Your contractor can provide a more precise estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically ranges from 15-30 minutes per switch for direct replacements, to several hours or a full day for more complex smart switch systems or whole-house upgrades.
